svg.title: Customer Churn MLOps — C4 Level 3, pipeline components
svg.desc: Three deployments trigger the flows. The full flow runs four blocking code gates (ruff format, ruff check, bandit, pytest), then prepare-data, train-model (RandomForest, 100 trees), evaluate-model (85.55% accuracy, recall 0.42) and save/load with joblib. After a run, flows.py logs it to MLflow through tracking.py and prints a JSON event through observability.py.

svg.text: Pure logic in model_pipeline.py; tasks.py wraps each job as a Prefect task; flows.py chains them.
